# Roobet Tracker

> Private gambling P&L tracker — bookmarklet ingest + monthly ROI dashboard. Single-user, Basic Auth protected.

## Pages

- [Dashboard `/`](/#overview): 30-day headline, rolling 24h/7d/30d metric cards, monthly trend chart, top games, ROI by game chart, sortable recent-bets table.
- [Month `/#month`](/#month): daily net P&L, ROI, best/worst bets for the selected month.
- [Games `/#games`](/#games): top games by bet count plus ROI-by-game chart at [`/#roi`](/#roi).
- [Recent bets `/#recent`](/#recent): sortable table with totals footer; import help at [`/#import`](/#import).
- `/api/stats?month=YYYY-MM`: JSON dashboard aggregates (auth required).
- `/api/ingest`: bookmarklet bet import endpoint (API-key required).

## Notes

- Dark OLED UI built from shadcn + Tailwind + 21st.dev MCP components (sidebar shell 14941, data table 1050).
- Data never leaves the owner's database (Supabase Postgres via Prisma).
